messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — we promised RCA and action items for last week's outage. I'll drop links and owners here. Please flag anything I miss.

sam: RCA posted: https://redwood-infra.internal/rcas/2024-04-24-nvme-autoscaler.pdf TL;DR: NVMe controller firmware bug exposed under steady-state I/O + aggressive autoscaler churn -> KV cache thrash -> elevated tail latency. Root fixes + mitigations listed in doc.

anika: Thanks. Is the firmware pin deployed everywhere yet or only in canary pools?

ryan: Pinned yesterday at 10:30 UTC for hosted/dedicated masters. Canary pool in prod-us-west started; no regressions observed in 12h. Still monitoring for perf drift.

leah: Support saw ~5–10% increase in 5xxs during the peak window. We've sent an initial update to affected accounts and queued the follow-up template.

maria: Action items from all-hands: 1) @sam - finalize RCA summary and push to incidents + ops-oncall (owner: sam). 2) @ryan - run controlled canary scale test and share metrics (owner: ryan). 3) @anika - add rollback + verification task to the roadmap and create follow-up ticket (owner: anika). 4) @leah - finalize customer comms template and coord with AMs (owner: leah). Please confirm ownership and ETA in-thread.

sam: Confirming ownership. I will add a 1-page summary and checklist to the RCA by EOD today and tag incidents.

anika: I'll create a ticket PD-4823 and put a brief in next product sync. ETA for ticket + acceptance criteria: tomorrow morning.

ryan: I'll run the canary scale test today and post the graphs in #eng-sre. Will also open a PR for an autoscaler throttling unit test spike.

devops-bot: Reminder: Incident 2024-04-24 RCA uploaded: https://redwood-infra.internal/rcas/2024-04-24-nvme-autoscaler.pdf (automated link).

leah: Customer comms draft here (internal docs): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-example-share — please comment, I'll iterate and send by EOD.

maria: :thumbsup: Appreciate the quick responses. Let's review progress in the weekly SRE sync (Thursday). If anyone runs into blockers, ping me or drop directly into #eng-oncall. Also, want a short blurb for the next all-hands slide deck — @sam, can you provide a 2-line summary for leadership?

sam: Yup, will post a 2-line summary and a single-slide RCA summary by tomorrow noon.

ryan: Noted. If we find perf boundary cases in canary, we'll pause rollout and revert pin as needed.

anika: Adding the action items to the product tracker now.

leah: I'll coordinate the customer emails once the support draft is finalized.

maria: Thanks team — closing thread for the live all-hands follow-up.
